✓ ML vs DL Gems page loads at /gem-ml-dl

bug_fix_details.issue: Position cards showed edit form (Save/Cancel) instead of Edit Levels/Close buttons
bug_fix_details.root_cause: isEditing = editingPosition === pos.position_id evaluated to null === null = true when position_id is null
bug_fix_details.fix: Changed to: isEditing = editingPosition !== null && editingPosition === (pos.position_id || pos.coin_id)
bug_fix_details.additional_changes: Updated all data-testid attributes and handlers to use pos.position_id || pos.coin_id as fallback
